phase_A_status: Fixed-budget terminal-stage pretraining. The A verifier gate is retained in the runner but is a no-op in practice: over the 40 formal runs it fired 0 times in 161 calls (criterion passes only at A-local 300/400, concentration only early, never at the same call), and all 40 runs exit A by budget exhaustion. Its calls are kept as diagnostics. Evidence: experiments/two_stage_formal_T2_20260915/A_stage_audit/.
phase_B_rationale: At cadence 100 the three consecutive eligible calls can only land on B-local 400/500/600, which requires concentration to cross 0.04 before B-local 400. Observed first-eligible median is B-local 500 for q=50 and 380 for q=60, so B advanced by verifier pass in 15/40 runs, all of them q=60, and 0/20 at q=50. At cadence 25 the window only has to be 50 updates wide; the 20-update offline replay predicts 38/40 fit. Evidence: experiments/two_stage_formal_T2_20260915/B_cadence_feasibility/.
phase_C_rationale: dReach/dW moves by a median 0.0035 per 20 updates while the threshold is 0.01, so a 100-update cadence samples past eligible windows. Of the 11 no-candidate formal runs, 5 passed through eligible policies the cadence-100 verifier never queried; 4 of them convert at cadence 25 and all 4 clear final_joint_pass. Evidence: experiments/two_stage_dense_c25_20260922/ and experiments/two_stage_dense_c25_rest_20260922/.
not_a_replay_warning: Changing the B cadence moves B's exit update, so training diverges from that point on. Unlike the C-only change, results under this protocol cannot be obtained by replaying the 2026-09-15 runs; they require fresh runs.
